subject: pharmacology
title: Gabapentinoids, Phenobarbitone, Status Epilepticus and Absence Seizures Integrated

steps.tx: **Gabapentin** was designed as a GABA analogue yet ignores GABA receptors, binding instead the alpha 2 delta subunit of voltage gated calcium channels and reducing excitatory transmitter release, which serves focal seizures modestly and neuropathic pain, its dominant modern use, substantially. Absorption saturates (bioavailability falls as dose climbs), kidneys clear it unchanged, and pregabalin, its more potent linear cousin, absorbed the pain and anxiety markets while inheriting the sedation, weight gain and misuse scheduling.
steps.say: Gabapentin is a calcium channel drug in GABA clothing; pain pays its salary now, seizures rarely.

left.title: Gabapentin facts
points: Alpha 2 delta calcium channel binding
Saturable absorption: diminishing returns per dose rise
Renal clearance, dose by creatinine clearance
Focal seizure adjunct, neuropathic pain mainstay

right.title: Gabapentinoid burdens
points: Sedation, dizziness, ataxia and weight gain
Misuse and dependence: controlled scheduling
Respiratory depression with opioids in overdose data
Withdrawal symptoms on abrupt cessation

steps.tx: **Gabapentin** was built to resemble GABA, yet it does not bind GABA receptors. Its site is the alpha 2 delta subunit of voltage gated calcium channels, and binding there reduces excitatory transmitter release. Focal seizures respond only modestly. Neuropathic pain, the dominant modern use, responds more convincingly. Gut absorption saturates, so a bigger dose is absorbed less efficiently, and the kidneys excrete the drug unchanged. Pregabalin is the more potent cousin with linear kinetics, and it inherited the sedation, the weight gain and the misuse controls.
steps.say: Gabapentin resembles GABA but actually binds the alpha 2 delta subunit of calcium channels and cuts excitatory release. Seizure control is modest, and neuropathic pain is now the main indication. Higher doses are absorbed less completely, and the kidney clears the drug unchanged. Pregabalin is stronger and absorbs in proportion to dose, with the same sedation, weight gain and misuse limits.

vis.caption: At a nerve terminal gabapentin occupies the alpha 2 delta subunit of a voltage gated calcium channel and excitatory release falls. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: **Phenobarbitone** from the sedative module returns as an antiepileptic elder: GABA enhancement at barbiturate sites suppresses focal and tonic clonic seizures cheaply and reliably, with a half life of days that forgives adherence lapses and punishes accumulation. Sedation, cognitive and behavioural effects (especially in children), enzyme induction and dependence explain its demotion where alternatives are affordable, yet global neurology still runs on it, and intravenous phenobarbital remains a refractory status option.
steps.say: Phenobarbitone is cheap, forgiving and cognitively expensive; the world still uses it, examinations still test it.

vis.caption: Diazepam, the benzodiazepine partner whose class opens the status epilepticus algorithm this lesson integrates. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.tx: **Status epilepticus** assembled end to end: five minutes of continuous seizure defines it, benzodiazepine first line (adequate dose, by any route available), one second line load among levetiracetam, fosphenytoin or valproate, then refractory care with anaesthetic infusion and EEG in intensive care. Glucose is checked and corrected, thiamine precedes it in alcohol histories, and the cause hunt (non adherence, infection, metabolic, autoimmune, structural) runs in parallel rather than after the convulsions stop.
steps.say: Five minutes starts the clock: benzodiazepine, one big second line load, intensive care, cause hunt in parallel.

nodes.label: Seizure at 5 minutes: status epilepticus declared
One second line load: levetiracetam, fosphenytoin or valproate
Refractory: anaesthetic infusion, EEG, intensive care

steps.tx: **Absence seizures** close the module's other pole: brief staring arrests with immediate recovery, 3 Hz spike wave on EEG, provoked by hyperventilation in clinic, and treated by ethosuximide when pure, valproate when tonic clonic company exists, lamotrigine when both ethosuximide and valproate fail the patient. Sodium channel blockers (carbamazepine, phenytoin, gabapentin, vigabatrin) can multiply absences, so the staring child worsened by carbamazepine is a syndrome error, not drug resistance.
steps.say: Absence wants T channel drugs; sodium blockers can manufacture more absences from a misread syndrome.

left.title: Absence essentials
points: Brief arrests, abrupt return, no postictal phase
Hyperventilation provokes attacks and EEG signature
Ethosuximide first for pure absence
Prognosis excellent in childhood absence epilepsy

right.title: Absence aggravators
points: Carbamazepine and phenytoin
Gabapentin, pregabalin and vigabatrin
Tiagabine (GABA uptake blocker) similarly
Reassess syndrome when seizures multiply on therapy

steps.tx: **Gabapentinoid prescribing** beyond epilepsy needs its own discipline because pain practice dwarfs seizure practice: start low at night, titrate over days, dose by kidney, judge at adequate dose and duration, and taper rather than abandon abruptly. Inadequate trials (too low, too brief) manufacture non responders, while indefinite escalation manufactures sedation and falls. Dependence and diversion controls now attach in many jurisdictions, reshaping repeat prescription habits.
steps.say: Pain dosing is slow, renal and judged fairly; taper out, never drop out.

nodes.label: Gabapentin started low at night, pregabalin twice daily
Judge pain function at adequate dose and duration
Continue, switch or taper: never stop abruptly

steps.tx: **Withdrawal and discontinuation** separate the antiepileptic cabinet into two temperaments: most agents taper over weeks to months after seizure freedom measured in years (two years is the usual conversation opener), while benzodiazepines, phenobarbital and gabapentinoids add physiological dependence requiring slower, symptom guided descent. Abrupt cessation after surgery, stock outs or patient experimentation is a leading preventable cause of breakthrough seizures and status, so supply continuity is pharmacology too.
steps.say: Two seizure free years opens the taper conversation; supply gaps close it with status epilepticus.

left.title: Standard taper logic
points: Discuss after about 2 years seizure free
One drug at a time over weeks to months
Driving restrictions during and after taper
Relapse risk counselled, highest early

right.title: Dependence prone agents
points: Benzodiazepines and phenobarbital: slowest tapers
Gabapentinoids: taper over at least a week, oftener longer
Withdrawal seizures and autonomic symptoms
Never let supply lapse in dependent patients

steps.tx: **Driving, contraception, bone health and mood** form the chronic review quartet examinations compress into single stems: seizure freedom intervals govern licences by jurisdiction, enzyme inducers demand non hormonal or high dose contraception planning (teratogenicity lesson next), long term therapy thins bone through vitamin D and direct effects, and depression screening matters because epilepsy, several of its drugs and suicidality warnings travel together.
steps.say: Review licences, contraception, bones and mood with the levels; chronic epilepsy care is a quartet, not a blood test.

left.title: Review quartet part one
points: Driving: seizure free intervals per local law
Contraception: inducer interactions planned around
Pregnancy intentions reviewed annually
Folate status in women of childbearing potential

right.title: Review quartet part two
points: Bone health: vitamin D, densitometry where indicated
Mood and suicidality screened and documented
Behavioural drug effects asked by agent name
Adherence and supply continuity confirmed

steps.tx: **Rescue medication** exports status treatment into the community: buccal midazolam for prolonged seizures in children and adults with care plans, rectal diazepam historically, now joined by intranasal midazolam in some systems. Families trained with written plans, dose by weight or age band, ambulance thresholds and post dose observation convert the algorithm of step three into kitchen table action, reducing both status duration and emergency attendances.
steps.say: Buccal midazolam and a written plan move the status algorithm from the resus bay to the kitchen table.

nodes.label: Written rescue plan with dose by weight band
Seizure reaches 5 minutes at home or school
Buccal midazolam given by trained carer
Ambulance if seizures continue, repeat per plan limits
